sources.title: IFRS 9 Financial Instruments — official issued-standard summary
sources.read_scope: Public official summary; no claim to have read licensed full standard
supported_claims: IFRS 9 concerns recognition/classification/measurement of financial instruments
Initial transaction-cost treatment depends on classification; FVTPL is an exception to capitalizing directly attributable transaction costs
limitations: Does not prescribe A-share matching, all customer account fee policies or a universal cost-basis method
This reference is an economic analysis ledger, not a statutory IFRS statement

sources.title: IFRS 13 Fair Value Measurement — official issued-standard summary
supported_claims: Fair value uses an orderly-transaction exit-price concept and a measurement framework
limitations: Does not guarantee a quoted bar price was executable for a particular order
No formal IFRS compliance claim

sources.title: GIPS Standards Handbook for Firms
sources.read_scope: Targeted full-page sections on trade-date accounting, transaction costs, valuation, external flows and TWR; not a claim of complete 9,000-line handbook reading
supported_claims: Trade-date accounting values transactions before cash settlement
Transaction costs are included even in gross-of-fees returns
TWR treatment should neutralize external capital flows with consistent methodology
limitations: 2020 edition framework, not a newly invented 2026 GIPS edition
Product borrowing selected principles is not GIPS compliance or verification

sources.title: 2026 CFA curriculum: Overview of the Global Investment Performance Standards

Return calculation, cash and fees, valuation and verification are distinct GIPS subjects
limitations: Curriculum year is 2026, not a claim that GIPS itself was replaced in 2026

Order state uses cumulative and remaining quantities

sources.title: 深圳证券交易所交易规则（2026年修订）
supported_claims: Securities generally cannot be resold before settlement except permitted revolving-trading instruments
Price/time priority and distinct auction/continuous matching apply
Unfilled quantity/cancellation confirmation require explicit handling
Mainboard and ChiNext price-limit profiles differ and include exceptions
Ex-right/ex-dividend reference pricing has explicit rules
Effective date is 2026-07-06
limitations: Selected rules are not a complete market-rule engine
Do not apply the ordinary-stock T+1 reference to all ETFs, bonds or other permitted intraday instruments
Broker cash reuse and settlement statements require separate channel evidence

sources.title: GIPS Q&A: external cash flow clarification
supported_claims: External flows are capital entering/exiting a portfolio
Income receipts and transaction costs are not external flows
Fee/expense treatment differs by gross-of-fees versus net-of-fees presentation and must be declared
limitations: FAQ also treats expense payments as external flows; do not extrapolate the transaction-cost statement to every expense category
Reference TWR covers explicit capital flows and transaction costs, not all fee presentations

supported_claims: A-share competitive-auction handling fee is 0.00341% of consideration in each direction in the shown schedule
The exchange charges members/other specified participants; this is not the complete client commission

Do not add this again if the broker commission already includes exchange fees
